description: If you are in the market for a great camera with capable zoom, you will find plenty of choices. With the ongoing memory crisis, prices are rising, and it's hard to find what you want at the right price. We have put together a short list of phones with great telephoto cameras to help you capture all the action from a distance.
title: Best Mobiles Under Rs. 70,000 With Telephoto Cameras in India

description: The budget smartphone segment in India has witnessed a significant shift recently. With memory prices skyrocketing, brands have either adjusted the pricing of their new models or cut down on specifications to keep costs at bay. However, there are still a few options you can consider that promise large batteries, high-refresh-rate displays, and decent performance for everyday use — all while keeping prices within reach of a wider audience. The OnePlus N6 Lite 4G, iQOO Z11 Lite, and Samsung Galaxy M17 are three such options, although they take different approaches to the segment.
title: OnePlus N6 Lite 4G vs iQOO Z11 Lite vs Samsung Galaxy M17: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Mobile gaming has become increasingly demanding, with games requiring more powerful processors, faster displays and better thermal management. If you are looking for a new gaming phone under Rs. 80,000 in India, here's a curated list of the best smartphones in India suitable for gaming. We have included key features and pricing to help you pick one based on your preferences and budget.
title: Best Gaming Phones Under Rs. 80,000 in India: iQOO 15, OnePlus 15, Realme GT 8 Pro, and More

description: The premium smartphone market is highly competitive in 2026. To strike a chord with buyers, brands must deliver the right features at a competitive price. Unlike the budget and mid-range segments, the higher end of the premium segment still delivers good value. We compare the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, Oppo Find X9s and the Vivo V70 Elite to find out which offers the best features and hardware.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE vs Oppo Find X9s vs Vivo V70 Elite: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: If you’ve ever recharged with a prepaid plan and instantly realised another plan offered better benefits, then you’re not alone. Choosing the right plan can sometimes be tricky, especially when your data requirements or calling needs change. You may have picked a plan with more data than you need, run out of daily data sooner than expected, or simply want a different validity period. If you’re a Jio user, then you have an option to select another plan without having to wait for your existing plan to run out. A new recharge can be added to the account and, depending on how it is managed, either remain queued for later or be activated immediately.
title: How to Change Jio Prepaid Plan: A Step-by-Step Guide
